title: Threats Report
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Output of threats-to-validity-writer. Covers all four validity dimensions: internal, external, construct, statistical. check_threats_coverage.py refuses emission if any of the four dimensions is missing (fewer than 4 dims = coverage violations).

threats.description: list of validity threats; must cover all four dimensions (internal/external/construct/statistical) — check_threats_coverage.py enforces completeness

validity_dimension.description: which validity dimension this threat belongs to; check_threats_coverage.py requires all four to appear

threat_text.description: description of the specific threat to validity

mitigation.description: mitigation taken or proposed; 'none identified' is a valid value when no mitigation exists

coverage_confirmed.description: set to true only after check_threats_coverage confirms all four dimensions present

missing_dimensions.description: populated by check_threats_coverage.py with any dimension not covered

run_ref.description: reference to the run this threats report covers
